site.name: M/V HONDIUS
site.desc: UNOG confirmed evacuation complete 11 May; all passengers and crew disembarked Tenerife, repatriation underway across 23 nations. ECDC reports 9 total cases (7 confirmed, 2 probable); vessel en route Rotterdam with 30 skeleton crew + Dutch nurse for full decontamination.

descChanges.prevDesc: El País confirms 10 possible infections and 3 deaths aboard vessel as of 11 May; Andes variant identified with no new mutations, high similarity to Argentina 2018-19 strains. No new infections reported since containment measures implemented; vessel en route Rotterdam with 30 skeleton crew + Dutch nurse for full decontamination.
